about: Queries main's slash matcher matched to NOTHING, for the differential guard (slash-differential.test.ts). The queries (slash-differential-queries.ts) are single words: each base (every block's internal name and each of main's keywords, lower-cased) with one character inserted: punctuation, invisible characters, Arabic marks and a sample of default-ignorable code points at each position, Latin accents at the start only; plus each character alone and doubled. noMatch[base][char] lists the insert positions main matched to nothing; '*' means every position. alone lists the single and doubled characters main matched to nothing. defaultIgnorable covers every Default_Ignorable_Code_Point at every position of its bases: every such query is a main no-match except those listed in matched. Invisible characters, marks and default-ignorables are written as \u escapes.
